texts.Index:PlatformIntro: Built with Sufi Platform — a modern framework for enterprise Blazor apps. Everything you need is already here: authentication, multi-tenancy, modular architecture, and a beautiful component library. Just start building your features.

texts.Index:ModuleBackgroundJobs: Background Jobs — Run tasks in the background.
texts.Index:ModuleFeatureManagement: Feature Management — Enable or disable features per tenant.
texts.Index:ModuleSettingManagement: Setting Management — Configure your app and email.
texts.Index:ModuleLocalizationManagement: Localization Management — Manage translations and languages.
